editorial.blurb: Tandoor Char House is a family-owned Indian gem where the chef's personal touch and generously portioned, thoughtfully prepared dishes make every meal feel like dining at a friend's home—just with an upscale edge.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during Restaurant Week for exceptional value, and don't skip the Dubai chocolate cake and falooda for dessert—the chef personally serves and shares the stories behind the family recipes.
